text: Qin Shi Huang completed the unification of China, founding the Qin Dynasty
The Han Dynasty was established after the fall of the Qin
Zhang Qian's mission to the west opened the Silk Road trade routes
Cai Lun improved the papermaking technique during the Han Dynasty
The Han Dynasty collapsed, beginning the Three Kingdoms period
Emperor Wen reunified China, founding the Sui Dynasty
The Tang Dynasty was founded, ushering in a golden age
The Mongols under Kublai Khan established the Yuan Dynasty
Zhu Yuanzhang founded the Ming Dynasty
The Qing Dynasty was established after the fall of the Ming
